name: Discharges
description: Count of discharge records, not distinct patients.

name: Hospitals
description: Hospitals with discharge records in the selected cohort.

name: Exact LOS Discharges
description: Records with exact LOS between 1 and 119 inclusive.

name: Avg LOS (under 120 days)
description: Mean exact LOS; excludes 120+ day stays.

name: Median LOS (under 120 days)
description: Median exact LOS; excludes 120+ day stays.

name: Censored Stays
description: Source reports LOS as 120+; exact duration is unknown.

name: Censored Share
description: Share of selected discharge records with capped LOS.

name: Estimated Cost
description: Sum of estimated costs in nominal 2024 USD; not paid amounts.

name: Avg Estimated Cost
description: Mean estimated cost per selected discharge.

name: Median Estimated Cost
description: Median estimated cost per selected discharge, including long stays.

name: Charges
description: Billed charges, distinct from cost and actual payment.

name: Matched Discharges
description: Exact LOS with at least 30 peer records across 3 other hospitals in its stratum.

name: Benchmark Coverage
description: Matched discharges divided by all selected discharges.

name: Observed Matched Days
description: Observed bed-days for the matched subset only.

name: Expected Matched Days
description: Sum of fixed leave-one-hospital-out peer means for selected matched records.

name: Observed Matched LOS
description: Mean observed exact LOS for the matched subset.

name: Expected Matched LOS
description: Mean peer-expected LOS for the same matched subset.

name: LOS Index
formula: IF([Matched Discharges] >= 30, DIVIDE([Observed Matched Days], [Expected Matched Days]))
description: 1.0 means observed equals expected. Suppressed below 30 matched records. Descriptive, not a clinical quality score.

name: Peer Reference
description: Reference value for the descriptive LOS index.

name: Selected Reduction
description: Illustrative assumption; defaults to 5% if no single scenario is selected.

name: Scenario Bed Days
description: Hypothetical reduction in matched observed days; not a forecast or measured saving.

name: Scenario Remaining Days
description: Matched baseline days less illustrative scenario reduction.

name: Eligible Avg Cost
description: Raw average cost; available when at least 30 LOS-matched records exist. Cost itself is not adjusted.

name: LOS Variance Days
description: Signed difference between observed and peer-expected matched bed-days.

name: Hospital Cost Rank
description: Dynamic hospital rank by estimated cost inside the current slicer selection.

name: Cumulative Estimated Cost
formula: VAR CurrentRank = [Hospital Cost Rank] VAR RankedHospitals = TOPN(CurrentRank, ALLSELECTED(Hospitals[HospitalName]), [Estimated Cost], DESC, Hospitals[HospitalName], ASC) RETURN SUMX(RankedHospitals, CALCULATE([Estimated Cost]))
description: Running estimated cost across hospitals ranked from highest to lowest cost.

name: Cumulative Cost %
formula: DIVIDE([Cumulative Estimated Cost], CALCULATE([Estimated Cost], ALLSELECTED(Hospitals[HospitalName])))
description: Cumulative share of selected estimated cost for the hospital Pareto visual.

name: Scenario Bridge Value
formula: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE(ScenarioBridge[Step]), "Observed matched days", [Observed Matched Days], "Illustrative reduction", -[Scenario Bed Days], "Scenario remaining days", [Scenario Remaining Days])
description: Signed values for the scenario waterfall; requires the disconnected ScenarioBridge table.
